description: Update an existing PDF's metadata (the Info dictionary). Only the given fields change; the rest are preserved. At least one of title / author / subject / keywords / creator / tdmReservation is required. In documents with XMP (/Metadata), dc:title etc. are synchronized to prevent divergence. tdmReservation (0 | 1) and tdmPolicy (URL) write the W3C TDM Reservation Protocol statement to XMP (tdm:reservation / tdm:policy, namespace http://www.w3.org/ns/tdmrep/); a document without XMP gets one. When the document declares PDF/A, the tdmrep schema is also described in pdfaExtension:schemas, so veraPDF does not fail ISO 19005-2 6.6.2.3 on it. For signed PDFs, preserveSignatures: true updates while keeping the signatures intact.

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the PDF to edit.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

preserveSignatures.description: Edit a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. Changes beyond the certification (DocMDP) permission level are refused.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

tdmPolicy.description: URL of the TDM policy (tdm:policy). Requires tdmReservation.

tdmReservation.description: W3C TDM Reservation Protocol (TDMRep) rights statement, written to XMP as tdm:reservation: 1 = text-and-data-mining rights are reserved, 0 = they are not. Not written unless given. In a PDF/A document the tdmrep schema is also described in pdfaExtension:schemas, which ISO 19005 requires for a non-predefined namespace.
